SELECT S.MATERIAL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*钢带编号*/ T.CX_MACHINE_CODE, /*机台编号，用于计算成型定额*/ T.UNIT_CONSUME, /*压延的单耗，用于计算成型可供时长*/ CASE WHEN (IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > 0 THEN (IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} ELSE 0 END TODAY_STOCK, /*当日库存计算公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) ，不能小于0*/ CASE WHEN (IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > IFNULL(T.USE_NUM, 0) THEN (IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} - IFNULL(T.USE_NUM, 0) ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY, /*16点半部件库存量 公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) -预计消耗量，不能小于0*/ IFNULL(T.USE_NUM, 0) CX_USE_QTY FROM T_XWYY_STOCK S LEFT JOIN (
) T ON S.MATERIAL_CODE = T.BIG_ROLL_CODE WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/

SELECT R.CORD_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CX_MACHINE_CODE ORDER BY CX_MACHINE_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE SEPARATOR ',') CX_MACHINE_CODE, /*机台编号，多个机台用逗号隔开*/ ROUND(MAX(R.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * R.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT / #{breadth}), 6) UNIT_CONSUME, /*压延的单耗 = 裁断单耗 * 工艺 / 幅宽，多种规格取最大值 */ ROUND(SUM(R.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY), 6) USE_NUM /*12点后半部件预计消耗量， 公式：（前日成型三班计划量 - 12点成型完成量) * 单耗 * 工艺 / 幅宽 */ FROM (SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC, R.EMBRYO_CODE, IFNULL(R.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) * IFNULL(CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000, 0) * IFNULL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1 / 1000, 0) / #{breadth} - IFNULL(F.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY,
IFNULL(CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000, 0) SIDEWALL_LENGTH, /*裁断单耗，单位毫米，要换算成米*/ IFNULL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1 / 1000, 0) TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, /*1#胎体布工艺，单位毫米，要换算成米*/ R.CX_MACHINE_CODE FROM (SELECT R.SCHEDULE_DATE, GROUP_CONCAT(concat(CX_MACHINE_CODE , '$' , EMBRYO_CODE , '$' , r.BOM_DATA_VERSION) ORDER BY CX_MACHINE_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION SEPARATOR ',') CX_MACHINE_CODE, R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION, SUM(R.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY) CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY R.SCHEDULE_DATE, R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION) R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
LEFT JOIN t_xwyy_schedule_result F ON F.BIG_ROLL_CODE = CI.CORD_SPEC AND F.SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_SUB(R.SCHEDULE_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND F.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.EMBRYO_VERSION = R.BOM_DATA_VERSION WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1 IS NOT NULL

IFNULL(CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000, 0) SIDEWALL_LENGTH, /*裁断单耗，单位毫米，要换算成米*/ IFNULL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2 / 1000, 0) TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, /*2#胎体布工艺，单位毫米，要换算成米*/ R.CX_MACHINE_CODE FROM (SELECT R.SCHEDULE_DATE, GROUP_CONCAT(concat(CX_MACHINE_CODE , '$' , EMBRYO_CODE , '$' , r.BOM_DATA_VERSION) ORDER BY CX_MACHINE_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION SEPARATOR ',') CX_MACHINE_CODE, R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION, SUM(R.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY) CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY R.SCHEDULE_DATE, R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION) R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION

mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*大卷编号*/ CASE WHEN (IFNULL(STOCK_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > 0 THEN (IFNULL(STOCK_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY /*库存量，不能小于0*/, S.ESTIMATE_STOCK_FLAG FROM T_XWYY_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/
mapper.sql: SELECT S.BIG_ROLL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*大卷编号*/ IFNULL(S.TODAY_STOCK, 0) * IFNULL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, IFNULL(P1.PARAM_VALUE + 0, 400)) STOCK_QTY /*库存量，由大卷换算成米数*/ FROM T_XWYY_ASSIST_REQUIREMENT S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH) ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH FROM T_CD90_BIG_ROLL WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BIG_ROLL_CODE ) B ON B.BIG_ROLL_CODE = S.BIG_ROLL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_PARAMS P1 ON P1.PARAM_CODE = 'STANDARD_SIZE' AND P1.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.select: SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(S.STOCK_QTY * CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT), 0) STOCK_QTY FROM ( SELECT S.MATERIAL_CODE CLOTH_CODE, /*帘布编号*/ (IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} STOCK_QTY /*16点半部件库存量 公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) - 预计消耗量*/ FROM T_CD90_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/ ) S INNER JOIN ( SELECT TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, AVG(TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT) / 1000 / #{breadth} TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, MAX(CORD_SPEC) CORD_SPEC FROM ( SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE ) CI ON CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE = S.CLOTH_CODE GROUP BY CI.CORD_SPEC
select param_code, param_value from T_CD90_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0' and param_code = #{paramCode}
SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, REMIND_FLAG FROM T_XWYY_BIG_ROLL_REMIND t WHERE t.DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH) CLOTH_LENGTH FROM T_CD90_BIG_ROLL WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BIG_ROLL_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_xwyy_stock ( stock_date, material_code, stock_num, del_flag, estimate_stock_flag) SELECT s.stock_date, s.material_code, CASE WHEN sum( s.stock_num ) > 0 THEN sum( s.stock_num ) ELSE 0 END, '0', '0' FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD( s.stock_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) stock_date, s.material_code, s.stock_num FROM t_xwyy_stock s WHERE s.stock_date = DATE_ADD( #{stockDate}, INTERVAL - 1 DAY ) AND s.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT r.schedule_date, r.big_roll_code, IFNULL( r.day_plan_qty, 0 ) + IFNULL( r.night_plan_qty, 0 ) - IFNULL( r.cx_class1_plan, 0 ) - IFNULL( r.cx_class2_plan, 0 ) FROM t_xwyy_schedule_result r WHERE r.schedule_date = #{stockDate} AND r.del_flag = '0' ) s GROUP BY stock_date, material_code ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_num = VALUES(stock_num)
